sentences.en: I’d like a couple of minutes to think about your offer.
sentences.zh: 我想要几分钟时间来考虑你的提议。

sentences.en: There are a couple of new books on the shelf, but I’ll check if anyone else needs them first.
sentences.zh: 书架上有几本新书，但我先看看其他人要不要。

sentences.en: We can have a couple of drinks after work to celebrate the project completion.
sentences.zh: 我们可以下班后喝几杯来庆祝项目完成。
